verify_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher (WebFetch's lookups failed for several hosts). All 28 findings confirmed; two wordings corrected (Spalding's filing lists the site's About page; White is named sheriff in an article of November 2021, not today).
note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance ran out partway, so the rest was read directly from county, city, school district and court sites with the kit's fetcher; several county hosts did not resolve (Fleming, Hickman, Lyon's .gov) or answered too little (Perry), and Breckinridge and Hart County Schools draw their board pages by script. Kentucky's 2022 county general recaps on elect.ky.gov are scanned PDFs with no text, so no earlier party runs were read from them; Wikipedia's list of fiscal court members carries party and year but no citations for its rows, so it was not used. Party pages listing Randy Bridges and Larry Allen Hicks are already kept in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json as lists, not endorsements. Nothing found for: Dale Leon Willis, Eric Bubba Johnson, Adam Bow, Rick "Richie" J. Kielman (an uncited Wikipedia row lists a Richie J. Kielman as Fleming District 3 magistrate; no official page reachable), Jeremy Lilly, Amanda McClure Ballantine, Katherine W. Shumate, Michael Keith Feltner, Laura Marie McHugh, Wayne E Bowling, Barry M. Brown, Brent Hagan (Lyndon's city site did not answer), Mark O Biggs, Michael A Sawin, Christopher Gatrost (his filing lists no website), Randy Bridges (sitting legislator; his filing lists no website and no campaign site was found).
